413.description: File count, single-file size, or combined request size exceeds the documented limit.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in the response.

response_format.description: Force JSON object or JSON-schema output, e.g. { "type": "json_object" }.

tools.description: Tool / function declarations the model may call.

stream.description: If true, partial deltas are streamed as server-sent events (OpenAI chat.completion.chunk), terminated by 'data: [DONE]'.

input.description: Responses input. Can be a string or an array of message / tool-result items.

tools.description: Responses tools, including function tools and built-in tools such as web_search_preview.

stream.description: If true, responses are streamed as OpenAI Responses SSE events.

temperature.description: Amount of randomness injected into the response (0–1).

top_k.description: Only sample from the top K options for each token.

tools.description: Tools the model may call; each has name, description and input_schema (JSON Schema).

tool_choice.description: Tool selection: { type: 'auto' } | { type: 'any' } | { type: 'tool', name }.

stream.description: If true, responses are streamed as Anthropic SSE events (message_start, content_block_delta, message_delta, message_stop).

generationConfig.description: Generation config. Also note: call :streamGenerateContent (instead of :generateContent) to receive a Gemini SSE stream.

responseSchema.description: JSON Schema for structured output (with responseMimeType application/json).

tools.description: Tools with functionDeclarations the model may call.

systemInstruction.description: System instruction as a Gemini Content object ({ parts: [{ text }] }).

size.description: Native WIDTHxHEIGHT dimensions or auto. GPT-Image 2 also accepts ratio shorthand with the deprecated resolution compatibility tier.

n.description: Number of images to generate. Billing scales with the image count.

aspect_ratio.description: Compatibility ratio shorthand such as 1:1, 4:3, or 16:9. Prefer native size dimensions.

resolution.description: Compatibility conversion tier used with ratio shorthand.

size.description: Model-specific image size or aspect ratio shorthand.

MediaResult.description: Completed task result. Image tasks use the OpenAI image format (image URL at data[0].url); video and audio tasks expose video_url/audio_url plus a urls[] array.

ImageTaskResult.description: Image task result (OpenAI image format). The image URL is at data[0].url.

MediaUrlResult.description: Video or audio task result. The primary URL is video_url or audio_url; every output is also listed in urls[].
